miniatura_conceptos.concepto: Split-screen composition: Left side shows a silhouetted special operations soldier in tactical gear with thermal/night vision effect (green and black tones). Right side features a heavily redacted/censored classified document with bold black redaction bars across text, visible 'CLASSIFIED' stamp. Center overlay: large bold white text reading 'UNITS THEY DON'T KNOW EXIST' with a thin red line accent underneath. Top corner: small red circle with 'DECLASSIFIED' marking. Background: dark military steel texture. Overall color palette: deep blacks, dark greens, blood red accents, and white text for maximum contrast and authority.
